<b>Vintage Nectar</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Vintage Nectar is one of the five ingredients required for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. It is given to [[Loyal Mergwin]] in the [[Choral Chambers]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Loyal Mergwin 01.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Loyal Mergwin 02.png!Loyal Mergwin in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
During <i>Great Taste of Pharloom</i>, Hornet can ask [[Creige]] in the [[Halfway Home]] for the Vintage Nectar, unless when Hornet is [[Cursed Crest|Cursed]]. He charges {{R|480}} for the Nectar, and asks Hornet to retrieve it herself. However, he neglects to mention that his basement is infested with the Skarr: when attempting to pick up the item, the room shakes and suddenly is filled with various Skarr enemies, starting an [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)|enemy gauntlet]]; the small Skarr ants that crawl across the ground in [[Hunter's March]] are also present. The door leading back upstairs locks.
